extraction_rules: Every value is transcribed from the paper's tables. PaperLab verified each headline value appears on the cited page of the PDF; it does NOT judge whether results reproduce. Comparison against a fresh run is recorded separately in the reproduction run record, and the verdict belongs to a human.
